draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Ambalavayal! The heritage museum here holds one of Kerala's largest collections of remnants, some dating back to the second century. The Edakkal Caves are just 4 km away.
draft.hungryLine: Ambalavayal is a small Wayanad town, so eat where the locals do in town before heading up to Edakkal.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Start at the Wayanad Heritage Museum in town, then head 4 km out to Edakkal for the caves.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Go up above the Edakkal Caves, where you can look out over the hills where Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Karnataka meet.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Ambukuthi mala, the tallest mountain in Wayanad district, is at Edakkal, just 4 km from here.

spots.name: Wayanad Heritage Museum
spots.detail: In town · Four galleries on Wayanad's tribal history and hero stones

spots.name: Edakkal
spots.detail: 4 km away · Home of the Edakkal Caves and big three-state views

spots.name: St. Martin De Pores Church, Ambalavayal

legends.title: Stones for heroes
legends.body: Decorated memorial stones were once used to mark the graves of heroes here. They're so old that even the oldest Tamil scripts mention them.

legends.title: Gods in clay
legends.body: One gallery is full of figurines of gods and goddesses from the region. It's a peek at what people here believed long ago.

tips.title: Go Tuesday to Sunday.
tips.body: The heritage museum keeps Tuesday to Sunday hours, so plan around Monday.

tips.title: Give the museum half an hour.
tips.body: It's a short and sweet visit, so you can easily pair it with Edakkal the same day.

story.title: The first traces
story.body: The museum's collection starts in the Neolithic age. People have lived around these Wayanad hills for a very long time.

story.title: Old remnants
story.body: Some of the finds kept here go back to the second century. It's one of Kerala's largest collections of its kind.

story.title: Hero stones and tribal life
story.body: Items up to the 17th century show tribal life, terracotta figures and memorial stones for heroes. They tell Wayanad's own story, not just Kerala's.

story.title: A museum town
story.body: The District Tourism Promotion Council runs the museum, and new galleries are being built. Ambalavayal is the closest town to the Edakkal Caves.
